status_meaning.working: unlocked on Windows with the generic nv-uefi-unlocker loader, matched results reported
status_meaning.port-only: unlocked on Windows only with a per-board port; the generic loader has no report yet
status_meaning.untested: no Windows report yet; the chip family is routed, so a careful replay-first test is reasonable
status_meaning.partial: the transaction completes but the speed-up is lost or missing on some boards
status_meaning.not-needed: already runs at full rate, nothing to unlock
